mapper.select: SELECT g.groupid, g.capacity, g.academicyear, g.semester, g.status FROM groups g JOIN group_member m ON m.groupid=g.groupid WHERE m.studentid=#{memberId} ORDER BY g.academicyear DESC,g.semester DESC,g.groupid
SELECT groupid,capacity,academicyear,semester,status FROM groups WHERE groupid=#{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT m.studentid, COALESCE(u.nickname, '룸메이트') AS nickname FROM group_member m JOIN users u ON u.studentid=m.studentid WHERE m.groupid=#{groupId} ORDER BY m.studentid
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND studentid=#{memberId}
SELECT title FROM post WHERE postid=#{groupId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leavegroup WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND status='PENDING'
SELECT leaveid,groupid,requesterid,reason,status FROM leavegroup WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND leaveid=#{leaveId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groups g JOIN group_member m ON g.groupid=m.groupid WHERE m.studentid=#{memberId} AND g.academicyear=#{year} AND g.semester=#{semester} AND g.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ruleagreement WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND ruleid=#{ruleId}
DELETE FROM ruleagreement WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND memberid=#{memberId}
DELETE FROM leaveconsent WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND memberid=#{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET assigneeid=#{successorId} WHERE groupid=#{groupId} AND assigneeid=#{memberId}
